title: So cute! The salt comes out easily and doesn't stick either!
text: So cute! The salt comes out easily and doesn't stick either!. These salt n pepper shakers are so cute and great! They look ultra cute and after being filled they really work great! I find them better than my normal salt container because I find they don't really hold as much humidity and just work better in general. I might have to replace all my salt shakers from now on.
